description: Production build size. Measured first, ratcheted second — no byte count here was invented. `standaloneBytes` is what the Dockerfile `runner` stage actually copies, so it is the number that governs the deployed artifact.
establishmentNote: DELIBERATELY UNSET. `.next` was never measured by any workflow, and a local Windows measurement is not the number a Linux runner produces. The first GitHub-hosted build records it; the numbers are then committed and the ratchet starts.
ratioRationale: Expressed as a MULTIPLE of the recorded baseline rather than an absolute ceiling, because an absolute ceiling would be a guess. 1.1 flags a 10% jump for a human to look at; 1.5 refuses a 50% jump outright — at that size change something structural happened and it should be deliberate.
